headline: Costco posted 11.6% sales growth on record gas sales and solid comps, while investing in lower food prices.

metrics.comp_label: Costco U.S. comp ex gas & FX

guidance_note: Costco does not give earnings guidance.
key_messages: U.S. comps +9.4% reported, +6.8% ex gas and FX; gas inflation added ~2.2 pts to total comps.
Worldwide traffic +2.4% (slowing from 3.1% in Q2), ticket +7.3% (+4.2% ex gas/FX).
Digitally enabled comps +21.5%; paid executive members +9.6% to 41.2M.
Core margins pressured by price investments in eggs, beef and other fresh staples; ex-gas gross margin up 1 bp.
Record gas volumes as members sought value amid rising pump prices.

consumer.pricing: Higher gas prices and transportation costs; Costco invested in lower prices on everyday food items.

macro_read: Rising gas prices pushed members toward value, but traffic and core comps stayed solid, suggesting middle/upper-income shoppers were still spending in spring 2026.
